findings.source_quote: It is said that it was his encounter with God at the bedside of that dying man that prompted Lyte’s noble hymn, “Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted hymn title into Norwegian. Replace the English quoted title with a faithful Norwegian rendering while preserving the quotation marks and surrounding HTML. For example: “Jesus, jeg har tatt mitt kors.” (Resulting sentence: …at møtet ved den døendes seng ga opphav til Lytes velsignede hymne, «Jesus, jeg har tatt mitt kors.»)
findings.translation_quote: Det sies at det var hans møte med Gud ved siden av den døende mannens seng som gav opphav til Lytes velsignede hymne «Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken.»
